lines.text: Is too a good word here?
Many learners say: This soup is too delicious.
Better: This soup is so delicious.
Too means more than you want.
So! The cake is so good!

data.why: Too means more than you want.
data.memory: Too is bad. So is great.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt “quá” có thể là lời khen, nhưng “too” trong tiếng Anh nghĩa là “nhiều quá mức.” Khen thì dùng “so.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “This soup is too delicious.” không? 😅 Để khen, hãy dùng “so”, không dùng “too”: “This soup is so delicious.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “so.” Hãy nói to một câu khen món ăn bạn thích với “so.” Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: “Too” means more than you want. To praise, say “so.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “This soup is too delicious.” To praise, use “so”, not “too”: “This soup is so delicious.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
